title: Rotation Averaging
hints: Averaging the 4 components directly fails because q and −q are the same rotation: half your inputs can cancel the other half.
Quick fix for small spread: flip each q_i so that q_i·q_0 ≥ 0, then sum and normalize. It's still not sign-invariant if q_0 is an outlier.
Markley's method: build the 4×4 matrix M = Σ w_i q_i q_iᵀ (sign-invariant!). The mean is the eigenvector of the LARGEST eigenvalue. SelfAdjointEigenSolver sorts ascending, so take the last column.
Alternative: Karcher mean. Start at q_0 and iterate R ← R·exp(mean_i log(Rᵀ R_i)) until the update is tiny.
